narrative: Sakana Fugu shipped as a router-model claiming Fable 5 parity, but within 48 hours Mollick ran it on standard coding tests and clocked roughly 30-minute waits with output that merely matched, leaving the scores unreproduced. That is the named mechanism: orchestration buys quality with wall-clock time accuracy-only leaderboards never surface, and the reporting itself frames latency as the hidden axis.
remaining_gap: Still one evaluator's anecdote on a standard test, not a cited benchmark formalizing a latency or cost-per-task column, nor a vendor publishing wall-clock SLAs.
